notes: Openspec's acceptanceCriteria array was empty despite their notes claiming they added 5 measurable ACs for three behaviors (SDK init, draft fetch, real-time events). I created all ACs from scratch based on the story title, description, and openspec's noted three behaviors. AC-1 through AC-4 cover the three core behaviors (init, draft, real-time) plus entry switching. AC-5 through AC-8 add edge cases: network interruption/reconnection, auth failure, reference resolution, and rapid-update coalescing. AC-9 covers the multi-market (GO, UP, MX) localization requirement from the title. AC-10 covers malformed data error handling. AC-11 covers accessibility. All ACs are observable outcomes (Given/When/Then) with no implementation instructions. I could not review source files (no tool access), so these ACs are based solely on the story context and openspec's notes — if implementation files reveal additional behaviors, those should be incorporated in a later pass.
